title: Economy Master Interface — Modular Rebuild v0.1
subtitle: Layout baseline: v2.10.1
principles: Human / Consumer TreeView lists wants and needs from most important survival needs to least important wants.
Comparator datagrids allow the user to choose visible columns and sort relative items to determine greatest value and fulfillment.
Catalog and source data support the needs tree; they do not replace it.
The four-level ribbon is a context lens and must never replace or duplicate the TreeView.
